A brace-diagram sits in the text (Generalis/Specialis; Sacrificia offerre/Deum ad sacrificium invocare). Left margin of the scan shows only the edge of the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.l: Generalis, vt nisi fide prius purgati, & sanctifica-
ti fuerimus in Christo, quaecunque a nobis sunt pro-
fecta Deo exosa fuisse. Postea autem accepta. Hag.2.
Specialis erat, vt non prius ad sacra cultus Dei
abdicatis externe & interne sceleribus se praepara-
sent, aduenirent: alias cultum maxime fore deo exo-
Specialis differentia est, quae ex sacris muneribus
Sacerdotium est munus diuinum, quo ex homi-
nibus assumptus sacerdos pro hominibus in ijs con-
stituitur, quae apud Deum agenda sunt, vt ad ipsum
Eius duo membra. { Sacrificia offerre. } Iob.42.8.
Sacrificium offerre, est illud prout praescriptum
est & ijs actionibus Deo dicare. Ibid. & ex praced.

page.notes: Marginal references are printed beside the text; the braces and their small labels are transcribed in place. The running head's right-hand part is shown in italics in the scan. Some letters in the lower-left margin are fragments of the neighbouring page and are omitted.
